lua.diag.missingDirective: missing -- af-prelude-version: {want}; the runtime refuses chunks without it
lua.diag.duplicateDirective: the prelude version may be declared exactly once
lua.diag.versionMismatch: the chunk declares prelude version {got}, but this runtime provides {want}
lua.diag.mismatchedEnd: repeat is closed by until, not end
lua.diag.luauContinue: "continue" is a Luau keyword and is not supported in Lua 5.1 (gopher-lua)
lua.diag.luauOperator: operator {op} is Luau syntax and is not supported in Lua 5.1 (gopher-lua)
lua.diag.luauInterpolated: backtick interpolated strings are Luau syntax and are not supported in Lua 5.1 (gopher-lua)
lua.diag.luauTypes: Luau type annotations are not supported in Lua 5.1 (gopher-lua)
lua.diag.returnFromLoop: returning from loop() restarts the loop; use session.exit() to end the session
lua.diag.streamFor: llm.stream cannot be used in a generic for: it yields across the bridge. Call next_delta() directly and close() on early exit
lua.diag.undeclaredAssignment: assignment to undeclared global {name}; add local
lua.diag.undeclaredAssignmentSuggest: assignment to undeclared global {name}; add local (did you mean {suggestion}?)
lua.diag.unknownFieldSuggest: unknown field {field} on {parent}; did you mean {suggestion}?
lua.diag.afOp: af.op is an engine internal; use session.*, llm.* and the other public namespaces
lua.diag.maintenanceOnly: {path} is limited to system and scheduler turns
lua.diag.capabilityMissing: {path} requires capability {capability}, which this agent does not enable
lua.diag.topLevelYield: {path} yields, so it cannot run at chunk top level; call it inside loop()
lua.diag.localLoop: loop must be a global function; the engine calls function loop(), not a local one
lua.diag.missingLoop: the chunk must define function loop(); the engine has nothing to start without it
lua.unavailable.io: io is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox; use files.* for storage and log.* for output
lua.unavailable.debug: debug is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.require: require is not available: every prelude name is already global
lua.unavailable.dofile: dofile is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.loadfile: loadfile is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.load: load or loadstring is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.package: package is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.collectgarbage: collectgarbage is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.env: setfenv and getfenv are not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.module: module is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
lua.unavailable.os: os is the AgentFlow os: env, time and date only
lua.doc.capabilityTip: The agent must enable this capability to make the call
lua.doc.maintenance: maintenance provenance only (system or scheduler turns)
lua.doc.yieldsTip: Parks the session: call it inside loop(), not at chunk top level
lua.status.errorsAndWarnings: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
lua.doc.streamNote: Call `next_delta()` directly; a generic `for` fails across the bridge.
lua.api.session: The current session: inbox, replies, pushes and durable state.
lua.api.session.inbox: Wait for the next inbound message. This parks the session.
lua.api.session.send: Reply to the active inbound message. Needs an active message: timer, cron and boot turns have none.
lua.api.session.reply: Finish the turn with a structured assistant message; an llm.forward result can be passed as it is. At most one per turn; a channel that cannot express tool calls refuses them rather than dropping them.
lua.api.session.send_delta: One fragment of a streamed answer. Held until end of turn when the agent's safety profile has filters.
lua.api.session.push: Send proactively to a channel. reply_to may be nil.
lua.api.session.push_user: Deliver a proactive message to a user's channel, resolved by identity.
lua.api.session.exit: End the session permanently. The loop never resumes.
lua.api.session.state: Durable per-session key/value store (64 KiB values, 256 keys).
lua.api.session.state.set: Store a JSON-encodable value for this session.
lua.api.session.state.get: Read a value; nil when the key was never set.
lua.api.session.state.delete: Remove a key from the session store.
lua.api.session.state.list: Every stored key and value for this session.
lua.api.log: Structured logging at the session's level.
lua.api.time.sleep: Park the session for a duration; it is idle, not busy-waiting.
lua.api.agent.info: The running agent's identity and effective settings, including per-user overrides and each memory store's locality (deployment, region or instance).
lua.api.agent.config: The deployment profile as data. Secrets appear as {env=...} or {cred=...} markers.
lua.api.agent.send: Deliver a message to agent:<name> or session:<id>. Subject to can_contact.
lua.api.agent.request: Send and wait for a reply; the timeout is in seconds.
lua.api.agent.reply: Answer a request. Use msg.provenance.request_id, never a payload field.
lua.api.agent.list: Visible sessions, scoped to the agent's contacts.
lua.api.agent.spawn: Start a child session from a spawn profile. spec is accepted but ignored.
lua.api.scheduler: Session-scoped timers delivered as timer messages.
lua.api.scheduler.cron: Cron subset: */N minutes or fixed minute/hour; the rest must be *.
lua.api.scheduler.cancel: Cancel a timer. Timers survive hot reload, so cancel before re-registering.
lua.api.llm: Model calls: chat, streaming, embeddings and reranking.
lua.api.llm.chat: One model call. opts: model, temperature, max_tokens, thinking, tools, tool_choice.
lua.api.llm.stream: Token stream. Call next_delta() directly; a generic for fails across the bridge. Call close() on early exit.
lua.api.llm.forward: Forward the current OpenAI-channel request to a model on the metered path. opts: model, messages, prepend, append, tools, params, max_tokens_cap. Does not finish the HTTP response; session.reply does.
lua.api.llm.embed: Embed a string, an array of strings, or mixed part tables.
lua.api.llm.rerank: Rerank documents; result indexes are zero-based.
lua.api.openai: The request behind the current OpenAI-compatible turn (read-only).
lua.api.openai.request: The full request as data. Refused above 4 MiB of JSON — forward it with llm.forward instead.
lua.api.memory: Personal memory records, scoped by the turn's identity.
lua.api.memory.write: Write a memory record into the agent's memory profile.
lua.api.memory.recall: Recall memories. Returns a list, unlike store.query's { records }.
lua.api.store: Raw scoped stores, for when memory profiles are too narrow.
lua.api.store.put: Write a record. opts: ttl seconds, vector embedding.
lua.api.store.query: Query a store; returns { records }, not a bare list.
lua.api.store.scopes: Enumerate scopes. Maintenance provenance only (system or scheduler turns).
lua.api.tools.list: Tool specs visible to this agent after skills and policy.
lua.api.tools.run: Run a tool. needs_confirm tools are intercepted and re-invoked with confirmed=true.
lua.api.tool.def: Declare a model-visible tool at chunk top level, before loop().
lua.api.shell: Shell commands: one-off sandbox jobs on a project, and SSH connections to remote machines.
lua.api.shell.run: Run one command as one sandbox job on a project. What it writes in the project is stored; nothing else survives. A non-zero exit is a result; a job that cannot run raises. opts: project, environment, workdir, env, timeout (seconds).
lua.api.shell.start: Queue the same job in the background and return at once. The result arrives in the inbox as a message with type "shell.result" and the job in msg.payload.
lua.api.shell.status: A background job's state and the tail of its output, from any instance.
lua.api.shell.cancel: Stop a running background job of this session.
lua.api.shell.spawn: Open an SSH connection (provider = "ssh", host, user, key_file), or get a sandbox handle that only remembers its options. Prefer shell.run for sandbox commands.
lua.api.shell.exec: Run a command on a handle: on the remote machine for SSH, as a sandbox job otherwise.
lua.api.shell.write: Write a text file: into the project for a sandbox handle, onto the remote machine for SSH.
lua.api.shell.destroy: Close an SSH connection. A sandbox handle has nothing to close.
lua.api.http: Outbound HTTP with a private-address guard.
lua.api.http.request: Any HTTP status is a completed request; ok means it completed. Needs net.http.
lua.api.os: The AgentFlow os: env, time and date only, all UTC.
lua.api.os.env: Read an engine environment variable; "" when unset.
lua.api.os.time: Current UTC time. Takes no arguments.
lua.api.os.date: UTC date table or strftime text. No local timezone.
lua.api.mail: IMAP and SMTP; credentials resolve in Go, never in Lua.
lua.api.mail.imap_fetch: Fetch messages. opts: host, port, user, mailbox, unseen, limit, auth.
lua.api.mail.smtp_send: Send a message. opts: host, port, user, from, to, subject, text_body, auth.
lua.api.files: User-scoped project files with engine-native commits and refs.
lua.api.files.put: Write a file. Scope is resolved from the turn's identity.
lua.api.files.commit: Snapshot the tree; opts: ref, message.
lua.api.files.checkout: Restore a ref or commit id.
lua.api.files.scratch: Scratch files shared with HTTP save_to and media handles.
lua.api.user: Read-only facts about the person the turn serves.
lua.api.user.usage: Token and quota usage for the user.
lua.api.user.has_credential: Whether a stored credential exists; never returns its value.
lua.api.user.get: Read one profile. Maintenance provenance only.
lua.api.runtime.triggers: The merged trigger list snapshotted at boot.
lua.api.credential.get: Resolve a credential the agent is allow-listed for. Every access is logged.
lua.api.json.encode: Encode a value. Empty tables encode as {}.
lua.api.json.decode: Decode JSON; raises on malformed input.
lua.api.af: Engine internals. Loop code should use the public namespaces instead.
lua.api.af.op: Internal bridge call. Prefer session.*, llm.* and the other public namespaces.
lua.api.af.version: The prelude version the chunk is running against.
lua.api.token_budget: Trim a prompt to the agent's history budget. Loaded from the token_budget support chunk.
lua.api.memory_routing_table: Rewrite a memory record before it is stored. Used by memory.write.
lua.api.memory_recall_handler: Recall hook for recency-based memory. Used by memory.recall.
lua.api.memory_semantic_recall_handler: Recall hook for semantic memory. Used by memory.recall.
